# Composio AI Product Ops — 100-App Toolkit & MCP Buildability Research

> Automated multi-pass research and verification study of 100 SaaS, developer, fintech, and AI apps across 10 categories.
> Source Repo: https://github.com/shrihari808/composio-productops-assignment

## Headline Metrics
- Total Apps Analyzed: 100
- Buildability Verdicts: {"Ready Today (Easy Win)": 50, "Buildable with Friction": 43, "Gated / Needs Outreach": 5, "Blocked / Not API-Native": 2}
- Auth Methods Frequency: {"OAuth2": 88, "API Key": 64, "Bearer Token": 62, "Basic Auth": 21, "JWT": 10, "App Token / Bot Token": 7, "HMAC / Signature": 6, "Other": 4, "No Auth / Open": 3, "CLI / Local Only": 2}
- Access Models: {"Self-Serve Free / Trial": 55, "Self-Serve Dev + App Review": 20, "Admin / Customer Account Required": 9, "Self-Serve Paid Plan": 7, "Partner / Sales-Gated": 6, "Open-Source / Local Tool": 3}
- MCP Status: {"Official MCP": 89, "None Found": 6, "Community MCP Only": 5}
- Composio Live Catalog Coverage (1,842 toolkits audited): {"Built API Only": 54, "Both Built + Provider MCP": 22, "Not in Catalog": 19, "Provider MCP Only": 5}
- Pass 2 Automated Corrections: 30 field fixes across 29 apps
- Human + Browser Audit (20-app stratified sample): Pass 1 exact accuracy 50.0% -> Pass 2 automated 80.0% -> Final audited 100.0%

- Net-New Easy Wins (Not in Composio + Ready Today): ['LiveAgent', 'Vonage', 'systeme.io', 'WooCommerce', 'fanbasis', 'SE Ranking', 'Reducto']
